title: Playwright for QA testers
why: Automated checks catch regressions on every change and free testers for exploratory work.
what_is_different: Testers moving from manual to automation must decide what to automate, design stable locators, manage test data, and report failures clearly.

extra_modules.title: From manual cases to automated checks
extra_modules.outcome: You can: choose what to automate first
topics: turning a manual case into a script
extra_modules.practice: Convert three manual regression cases to automated tests

starter_project: Automate the top 10 regression checks of a sample app, run them in CI, and add an accessibility check.
